checkpoints.description: [1/5] Payment operations: advisory state locks, watcher fault isolation, cancel/grant/issue commands

impact_assessment.why: The order flow lacks concurrency protection, has no recovery when issuance fails mid-pass, and offers no way to close an abandoned or manually settled order
impact_assessment.benefits: One watcher per state directory, per-order fault isolation, and operator commands for cancellation and manual settlement
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new payments subcommands and cancelled status; dependency: stdlib only (os, time, contextlib); concurrency: O_EXCL lock files with stale recovery; state: optional reason field on orders, store version unchanged
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for lock contention, stale locks, cancelled orders and issuance failure, plus atomic writes
